browserStorage.purpose: Persist the Supabase user session with the operating system's secure storage boundary on iOS and Android.
Persist the Supabase session for the Expo web rich client, which must read and refresh its own tokens.

forbidden: document.cookie or custom Set-Cookie session handling in the Expo application
analytics, advertising, fingerprinting, replay, or cross-site tracking cookies
copying native sessions into a browser cookie model
storing raw teen, journal, voice, media, health, or parent-visibility content in cookies
claiming an HttpOnly SSR session without a separately approved server-rendered web architecture
notes: The current storage adapter is implemented in utils/supabase/client.ts.
Native and web session storage are deliberately different because the runtime capabilities differ.
A future server-rendered web app requires a new cookie manifest and separate privacy/security review.
